sec02-card-sec02-F001.front: Which four subject areas from the DC manual are tested on the knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F001.expected_back: The knowledge examination covers traffic law, road rules, vehicle law and safe driving practices described in the manual.

sec02-card-sec02-F002.front: May an applicant look up answers in the driver manual during the DC knowledge exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F002.expected_back: Candidates may not consult the driver manual while taking the examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F003.front: What credential is mandatory to operate a motor vehicle or motorcycle on District public streets?
sec02-card-sec02-F003.expected_back: A person driving a motor vehicle or motorcycle on District public roads must hold a driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-F004.front: Within how many days of moving into the District must a new resident obtain a DC driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F004.expected_back: A new District resident must obtain a DC driver license within sixty days of moving there.

sec02-card-sec02-F005.front: What minimum ages does the DC handbook set for a learner permit versus a driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F005.expected_back: The handbook lists seventeen as the minimum driver-license age and sixteen as the learner-permit age.

sec02-card-sec02-F006.front: Along with legal name, birth date, and Social Security number, how many DC residence proofs must you bring?
sec02-card-sec02-F006.expected_back: An applicant must document legal name, birth date, Social Security number and two proofs of District residence.

sec02-card-sec02-F007.front: Which three tests or screenings must a standard DC driver-license applicant pass?
sec02-card-sec02-F007.expected_back: The licensing requirements include passing vision screening, a knowledge examination and a road-skills examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F008.front: At what age range must a DC license or permit applicant provide parent or guardian consent?
sec02-card-sec02-F008.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen needs consent from a parent or guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-F009.front: What must applicants do with an existing license or ID card, alongside meeting medical rules?
sec02-card-sec02-F009.expected_back: Applicants must surrender a previously held license or identification card and meet the medical requirements.

sec02-card-sec02-F010.front: Which three adverse license statuses disqualify an applicant from ordinary DC licensing eligibility?
sec02-card-sec02-F010.expected_back: The handbook excludes an applicant whose license is suspended, revoked or denied from its ordinary licensing eligibility list.

sec02-card-sec02-F011.front: Which vehicle type does the standard DC driver manual cover, and what requires separate manuals?
sec02-card-sec02-F011.expected_back: This manual addresses non-commercial passenger-car driving; commercial vehicles and motorcycles require their respective manuals.

sec02-card-sec02-F012.front: Under which license-class label does the DC handbook group its sample passenger-car exam items?
sec02-card-sec02-F012.expected_back: The source labels its passenger-car sample examination questions as Class D questions.

sec02-card-sec02-F013.front: Where does DC DMV administer the knowledge exam, and what support feature does the manual note?
sec02-card-sec02-F013.expected_back: The knowledge examination is offered at DMV service centers, with language availability described in the manual.

sec02-card-sec02-F014.front: How are questions presented and answered on DC DMV's automated exam terminals?
sec02-card-sec02-F014.expected_back: The handbook also describes an audio or visual examination format with touch-screen responses.

sec02-card-sec02-F015.front: Which two exams must a foreign national pass when converting a valid foreign driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F015.expected_back: A foreign national converting a valid foreign license must pass the knowledge and vision examinations.

sec02-card-sec02-F016.front: What requirement kicks in once a DC driver license has been expired more than three hundred sixty-five days?
sec02-card-sec02-F016.expected_back: After a DC license has been expired for more than three hundred sixty-five days, the handbook requires a knowledge examination or the DC online traffic-school course.

sec02-card-sec02-F017.front: Which exams are required if your DC license stays expired more than five hundred forty-five days?
sec02-card-sec02-F017.expected_back: A DC license expired for more than five hundred forty-five days requires both the knowledge examination and the road-skills examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F018.front: Which two examinations are mandatory when reinstating a revoked DC driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F018.expected_back: Reinstatement after license revocation requires passing the knowledge and road-skills examinations.

sec02-card-sec02-F019.front: At what expiration-date age must a DC applicant or renewer submit the physician-completed Mature Driver section?
sec02-card-sec02-F019.expected_back: A license applicant or renewing driver who will be at least seventy when the license expires needs the physician-completed Mature Driver section of the application.

sec02-card-sec02-F020.front: How long must a candidate wait to retest after failing the DC knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F020.expected_back: After failing the knowledge examination, a candidate must wait three calendar days before another attempt.

sec02-card-sec02-F021.front: What penalty triggers if an applicant fails the DC knowledge examination six times in a row?
sec02-card-sec02-F021.expected_back: Six consecutive knowledge-examination failures postpone further testing until twelve months after the first failed examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F022.front: What two visual abilities does DMV vision screening check, and what is it not?
sec02-card-sec02-F022.expected_back: Vision screening checks visual and peripheral ability against the District's driving standards; it is not a medical examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F023.front: What document is required if an applicant fails the service-center vision screening?
sec02-card-sec02-F023.expected_back: A failed vision screen requires an Eye Report from an eye-care professional.

sec02-card-sec02-F024.front: What requirement and license notation apply when you need glasses or contacts to pass vision screening?
sec02-card-sec02-F024.expected_back: A driver who needs corrective lenses to pass vision screening must wear them while driving and receives the corresponding license restriction.

sec02-card-sec02-F025.front: How can a driver remove a corrective-lens restriction after laser vision surgery?
sec02-card-sec02-F025.expected_back: Removing a corrective-lens restriction after laser surgery requires a doctor's certification.

sec02-card-sec02-F026.front: Which five driving elements are evaluated on District streets during the road-skills exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F026.expected_back: The road-skills examination includes traffic driving, signaling, vehicle control, maneuvers and parallel parking on District roads.

sec02-card-sec02-F027.front: What dollar fee does the DC manual list for each road-skills examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F027.expected_back: The source lists a ten-dollar fee for each road-skills examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F028.front: How does holding a valid same-class license from another state affect the DC road-skills test?
sec02-card-sec02-F028.expected_back: Converting a valid same-class license from another state generally waives the road-skills examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F029.front: What two prerequisites are needed to schedule a DC road-skills examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F029.expected_back: Scheduling a road-skills examination requires an appointment and a valid learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F030.front: What charge applies when a candidate misses the two-business-day window to cancel a booked road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F030.expected_back: The handbook describes a thirty-dollar charge for failing to cancel a road-test appointment within two business days; DMV cancellation is excluded.

sec02-card-sec02-F031.front: How early must you arrive for your DC road test, and what kind of car is required?
sec02-card-sec02-F031.expected_back: For the road test, arrive at least ten minutes early and bring a vehicle meeting the stated test requirements.

sec02-card-sec02-F032.front: Along with your valid learner permit, who must accompany you to the road-skills appointment?
sec02-card-sec02-F032.expected_back: Bring a valid learner permit to the road-skills appointment and arrive with a fully licensed accompanying driver aged at least twenty-one.

sec02-card-sec02-F033.front: Which two vehicle documents and personal safety habit are mandatory for the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F033.expected_back: A road-test vehicle needs valid registration and insurance, and the candidate must wear a seat belt.

sec02-card-sec02-F034.front: What extra document must GRAD participants aged sixteen through twenty bring to the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F034.expected_back: GRAD participants aged sixteen through twenty must bring the completed provisional-license eligibility certificate.

sec02-card-sec02-F035.front: What happens if a learner drives to the road-test site without the required licensed adult?
sec02-card-sec02-F035.expected_back: A learner who drives to the road test without the required licensed adult cannot take the examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F036.front: At least how many hours must pass after failing a DC road-skills exam before retesting?
sec02-card-sec02-F036.expected_back: A failed road-skills examination requires a wait of at least seventy-two hours before another attempt.

sec02-card-sec02-F037.front: What waiting period applies after six consecutive failures on the DC road-skills examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F037.expected_back: After six consecutive road-skills failures, another test is barred until twelve months after the first failed attempt.

sec02-card-sec02-F038.front: What safety control inside a private road-test vehicle must the examiner be able to reach?
sec02-card-sec02-F038.expected_back: The examiner must be able to reach an appropriate emergency braking or other approved safety device in the road-test vehicle.

sec02-card-sec02-F039.front: Which two facts must appear on the insurance proof presented for a road-test vehicle?
sec02-card-sec02-F039.expected_back: A test vehicle's insurance evidence must identify the vehicle and show when coverage expires.

sec02-card-sec02-F040.front: Which exterior stickers and plates must a road-test vehicle display?
sec02-card-sec02-F040.expected_back: The test vehicle must display any inspection sticker and license tags required by its registration state.

sec02-card-sec02-F041.front: Which five exterior signals or cabin controls must operate properly on a road-test car?
sec02-card-sec02-F041.memory_hook: Brake lights, blinkers, horn, windows, doors
sec02-card-sec02-F041.expected_back: The road-test vehicle needs working brake lamps, turn signals, horn, windows and doors.

sec02-card-sec02-F042.front: What mirror setup must a vehicle have to pass DC road-test inspection?
sec02-card-sec02-F042.expected_back: Road-test mirrors must include a rearview mirror and properly placed mirrors on both sides.

sec02-card-sec02-F043.front: What condition must the test car's windshield and inside mirror meet?
sec02-card-sec02-F043.expected_back: The test vehicle needs an unobstructed, uncracked windshield and nothing hanging from its rearview mirror.

sec02-card-sec02-F044.front: What tire condition is required for the DC road test, and what spare type is rejected?
sec02-card-sec02-F044.expected_back: Road-test tires must be sound and properly inflated; temporary donut tires are unacceptable.

sec02-card-sec02-F045.front: When is a candidate allowed to take the DC road-skills test in a rental car?
sec02-card-sec02-F045.expected_back: A rental test vehicle is permitted only when the candidate is an approved driver on the rental agreement with appropriate insurance.

sec02-card-sec02-F046.front: How do lit dashboard service lamps or a low-fuel light affect road-test eligibility?
sec02-card-sec02-F046.expected_back: Illuminated dashboard warning or service lamps, including low-fuel warnings, make a vehicle unacceptable for the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-F047.front: Which three broad issues can trigger cancellation of a scheduled road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F047.expected_back: Unsafe examiner access, dangerous weather or unmet candidate or vehicle requirements can cause road-test cancellation.

sec02-card-sec02-F048.front: What vehicle option and fee rule apply when you book your road test directly with DC DMV?
sec02-card-sec02-F048.expected_back: Candidates testing directly with DC DMV may choose a DMV road-test vehicle without an additional vehicle-use fee.

sec02-card-sec02-F049.front: Can you request a DC DMV fleet vehicle when taking a road test scheduled through a third party?
sec02-card-sec02-F049.expected_back: The DMV vehicle option is unavailable for tests scheduled through a third party.

sec02-card-sec02-F050.front: What paperwork must you sign before taking your road test inside a DC DMV vehicle?
sec02-card-sec02-F050.expected_back: Using a DMV road-test vehicle requires completing the consent, waiver and indemnity form.

sec03-card-sec03-F001.front: Which age group must participate in DC's Gradual Rearing of Adult Drivers program?
sec03-card-sec03-F001.expected_back: Drivers younger than twenty-one participate in the Gradual Rearing of Adult Drivers program, known as GRAD.

sec03-card-sec03-F002.front: How does the GRAD program help novice drivers aged sixteen through twenty?
sec03-card-sec03-F002.expected_back: GRAD lets novice drivers aged sixteen through twenty build experience before receiving full driving privileges.

sec03-card-sec03-F003.front: Who must sit in the front passenger seat every time a DC learner permit holder drives?
sec03-card-sec03-F003.expected_back: A learner may drive only with a fully licensed supervisor aged at least twenty-one sitting beside the learner in the front passenger seat.

sec03-card-sec03-F004.front: What minimum age and two DMV tests are required to get a DC learner permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F004.expected_back: A learner-permit applicant must be at least sixteen and pass the knowledge examination and vision screening.

sec03-card-sec03-F005.front: Which learner-permit applicants must also submit a signed parent or guardian consent form?
sec03-card-sec03-F005.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen also needs a parent- or guardian-signed consent form.

sec03-card-sec03-F006.front: How long does a DC learner permit last for U.S. citizens, and can it be renewed?
sec03-card-sec03-F006.expected_back: The handbook describes a nonrenewable two-year learner permit for United States citizens.

sec03-card-sec03-F007.front: What must you do to get another learner permit if your first DC permit expires?
sec03-card-sec03-F007.expected_back: An expired learner permit requires passing the knowledge examination again to obtain another permit.

sec03-card-sec03-F008.front: How many consecutive point-free months are required before a learner qualifies for a provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F008.expected_back: Provisional-license eligibility requires six consecutive months without a moving violation for which points were or could have been assessed.

sec03-card-sec03-F009.front: What minimum age and minimum permit-holding time apply for a DC provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F009.expected_back: A provisional-license applicant must be at least sixteen years and six months old and have held a valid learner permit for at least six months.

sec03-card-sec03-F010.front: How many hours of certified supervised driving with twenty-one-plus licensed drivers are needed for a provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F010.expected_back: Provisional applicants must submit certification of at least forty hours of practice with fully licensed drivers aged at least twenty-one.

sec03-card-sec03-F011.front: Which DMV test must a learner pass to move up to a DC provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F011.expected_back: Passing the road-skills examination is required for the provisional license.

sec03-card-sec03-F012.front: What validity period and renewal status apply to a DC provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F012.expected_back: The source gives the provisional license a renewable one-year term.

sec03-card-sec03-F013.front: May a provisional driver under age eighteen drive a vehicle for pay?
sec03-card-sec03-F013.expected_back: A provisional driver younger than eighteen may not drive a vehicle for compensation.

sec03-card-sec03-F014.front: What minimum provisional holding time and clean-driving streak are required for a full GRAD license?
sec03-card-sec03-F014.expected_back: The source's full-license pathway calls for at least six months holding a provisional license and twelve consecutive months without pointable moving violations.

sec03-card-sec03-F015.front: How many certified nighttime practice hours with twenty-one-plus licensed adults are required for a full GRAD license?
sec03-card-sec03-F015.expected_back: The full-license application requires certified practice of at least ten nighttime hours with fully licensed drivers aged at least twenty-one.

sec03-card-sec03-F016.front: How does the licensing pathway work for a new learner aged twenty-one or older outside GRAD?
sec03-card-sec03-F016.expected_back: An applicant outside GRAD may proceed from learner requirements to a full license after passing the road-skills examination.

sec03-card-sec03-F017.front: Up to what vehicle weight rating and passenger-van capacity does a regular DC non-commercial license cover?
sec03-card-sec03-F017.expected_back: The regular non-commercial license covers vehicles rated below twenty-six thousand one pounds and passenger vans carrying up to fifteen passengers, as described in the source.

sec03-card-sec03-F018.front: Between what hours of the day may a DC learner permit holder drive?
sec03-card-sec03-F018.expected_back: Learner-permit driving hours are limited to six in the morning through nine in the evening every day.

sec03-card-sec03-F019.front: From September through June, what are Monday-through-Thursday driving hours for a provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F019.expected_back: From September through June, provisional-license driving hours run from six oh one in the morning to ten fifty-nine at night Monday through Thursday.

sec03-card-sec03-F020.front: From September through June, what are Friday-through-Sunday driving hours for a provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F020.expected_back: From September through June, provisional-license driving hours extend to eleven fifty-nine at night Friday through Sunday, starting at six oh one in the morning.

sec03-card-sec03-F021.front: What daily driving hours apply to provisional drivers during July and August?
sec03-card-sec03-F021.expected_back: During July and August, provisional-license driving hours run daily from six oh one in the morning to eleven fifty-nine at night.

sec03-card-sec03-F022.front: Which nighttime driving schedule applies to full-license holders aged seventeen to eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-F022.expected_back: For full-license drivers aged seventeen to eighteen, the listed seasonal driving-hour schedule matches the provisional-license schedule.

sec03-card-sec03-F023.front: Which trips qualify for an exception to GRAD's restricted nighttime driving hours?
sec03-card-sec03-F023.expected_back: GRAD's restricted-hour exceptions include travel to or from work and qualifying school, religious, athletic or sponsored activities described in the handbook.

sec03-card-sec03-F024.front: Who riding in the front seat also exempts a GRAD driver from nighttime curfew hours?
sec03-card-sec03-F024.expected_back: Another restricted-hour exception applies with a fully licensed adult aged at least twenty-one seated beside the driver and wearing a seat belt.

sec03-card-sec03-F025.front: Which two GRAD hurdles drop away once a learner-permit holder turns twenty-one?
sec03-card-sec03-F025.expected_back: A GRAD learner who reaches twenty-one can schedule a road test without the practice-certification form or six-month permit holding period.

sec03-card-sec03-F026.front: How can a provisional license holder upgrade upon turning twenty-one?
sec03-card-sec03-F026.expected_back: A provisional driver reaching twenty-one can obtain a full license at a service center without the practice-certification form or six-month holding period.

sec03-card-sec03-F027.front: Can a learner drive solo, and who inside the car must buckle up?
sec03-card-sec03-F027.expected_back: Learner drivers cannot drive alone and both the learner and supervising passenger must be belted.

sec03-card-sec03-F028.front: What three things are banned on a learner permit regarding pay, commercial rigs, and passengers?
sec03-card-sec03-F028.expected_back: A learner may not drive for compensation, operate a commercial vehicle or carry passengers other than the required supervisor.

sec03-card-sec03-F029.front: May a DC learner permit holder use a hands-free phone or Bluetooth while driving?
sec03-card-sec03-F029.expected_back: A learner is prohibited from using a mobile phone or another electronic device while driving, even with hands-free accessories.

sec03-card-sec03-F030.front: When driving on a DC provisional license, which passengers are allowed in your car?
sec03-card-sec03-F030.expected_back: A provisional license allows driving alone but otherwise limits occupants to the qualifying front-seat supervising adult and the driver's siblings, children or parents.

sec03-card-sec03-F031.front: What belt and schedule rules remain active throughout the provisional license stage?
sec03-card-sec03-F031.expected_back: Provisional drivers and their passengers must wear seat belts, and the provisional driving-hour restrictions continue to apply.

sec03-card-sec03-F032.front: How many consecutive violation-free months must a provisional driver complete to advance to a full license with conditions?
sec03-card-sec03-F032.expected_back: A provisional driver needs twelve consecutive violation-free months before advancing to a full license with conditions.

sec03-card-sec03-F033.front: How many passengers under twenty-one may a full-license driver under eighteen carry, and who is exempt?
sec03-card-sec03-F033.expected_back: A full-license driver younger than eighteen may carry no more than two passengers younger than twenty-one, excluding the driver's siblings or child from that limit.

sec03-card-sec03-F034.front: Which vehicles and trip purpose are allowed for a full-license driver younger than eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-F034.expected_back: A full-license driver younger than eighteen may use only a passenger vehicle or motorized bicycle for pleasure rather than paid driving.

sec03-card-sec03-F035.front: Who gets notified if a full-license driver younger than eighteen commits a GRAD violation?
sec03-card-sec03-F035.expected_back: The parent or guardian of a full-license driver younger than eighteen receives notice of GRAD violations.

sec03-card-sec03-F036.front: How does a pointable moving violation during the learner stage affect provisional eligibility?
sec03-card-sec03-F036.expected_back: A pointable learner-stage violation extends the wait for provisional eligibility; the required clean interval is six consecutive months.

sec03-card-sec03-F037.front: What triggers a ninety-day suspension and reinstatement fee during the learner stage?
sec03-card-sec03-F037.expected_back: During the learner stage, accumulating at least eight points or violating a GRAD restriction can trigger a ninety-day suspension and a reinstatement fee.

sec03-card-sec03-F038.front: How does a pointable moving ticket during the provisional stage affect advancing to a full license?
sec03-card-sec03-F038.expected_back: During the provisional stage, a pointable moving violation extends the wait to advance to the full-license stage.

sec03-card-sec03-F039.front: Which three suspension lengths apply to provisional GRAD restriction violations based on repeat count?
sec03-card-sec03-F039.expected_back: A provisional GRAD restriction violation can bring a thirty-, sixty- or ninety-day suspension depending on the number of such violations.

sec03-card-sec03-F040.front: At what point total is a provisional driver automatically suspended, separate from GRAD restriction rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F040.expected_back: A provisional driver is also automatically suspended upon reaching ten points, independently of the GRAD restriction penalties.

sec03-card-sec03-F041.front: What financial requirement applies before a suspended provisional license can be reinstated?
sec03-card-sec03-F041.expected_back: Reinstating a suspended provisional license requires payment of a reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F001.front: How does the DC manual describe the purpose of organ and tissue donation?
sec04-card-sec04-F001.expected_back: The manual describes organ and tissue donation as a choice that can help recipients through transplantation.

sec04-card-sec04-F002.front: At what minimum age can a DC license applicant record donor status by answering yes on the application?
sec04-card-sec04-F002.expected_back: A District driver-license applicant aged at least eighteen may record an intention to donate by answering yes to the donation question.

sec04-card-sec04-F003.front: Why should a prospective organ donor share their decision with family and close contacts?
sec04-card-sec04-F003.expected_back: A prospective donor should tell family and other close contacts so they can communicate that choice.

sec04-card-sec04-F004.front: Which three professional or spiritual advisors does the DC manual also suggest informing of donor wishes?
sec04-card-sec04-F004.expected_back: The source encourages sharing donation wishes with a physician, faith leader and attorney as well.

sec04-card-sec04-F005.front: Which two organizations does the DC manual name for learning more about organ donation?
sec04-card-sec04-F005.expected_back: The manual identifies the federal organ-donation information service and Donate Life Washington DC as places to learn more.

sec04-card-sec04-F006.front: Which federal military-readiness registration can be completed on a DC DMV license application?
sec04-card-sec04-F006.expected_back: The DMV license application can be used to register for Selective Service.

sec04-card-sec04-F007.front: Which male age range is covered by DC DMV's Selective Service registration process unless waived?
sec04-card-sec04-F007.expected_back: The source describes DMV registration for males aged eighteen through twenty-five unless they use the waiver to decline registration through that process.

sec04-card-sec04-F008.front: How does a DC license or ID application handle voter registration for eligible applicants?
sec04-card-sec04-F008.expected_back: A District license or identification-card application automatically registers the applicant to vote unless the applicant declines, subject to voter eligibility.

sec04-card-sec04-F009.front: What nationality and residency rules appear on the DC handbook's voter-registration checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F009.expected_back: The handbook's voter-registration list requires United States citizenship and District residence.

sec04-card-sec04-F010.front: What age milestone must a DC voter-registration applicant reach by the next election?
sec04-card-sec04-F010.expected_back: The handbook lists being at least eighteen by the next election as a voter-registration requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F011.front: What out-of-jurisdiction voting claim disqualifies an applicant on DC's voter-registration list?
sec04-card-sec04-F011.expected_back: Its voter-registration list excludes claiming a voting right outside the District.

sec04-card-sec04-F012.front: What court-ordered mental-status ruling appears as a bar on the DC voter-registration list?
sec04-card-sec04-F012.expected_back: The source also lists not having been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court among its voter-registration conditions.

sec04-card-sec04-F013.front: Within how many weeks after completing your DMV application should a DC voter-registration card arrive?
sec04-card-sec04-F013.expected_back: The handbook says a voter-registration card should arrive within three weeks after the application is completed.

sec04-card-sec04-F014.front: Which agency handles follow-up questions about DC voter registration?
sec04-card-sec04-F014.expected_back: Voter-registration questions can be directed to the District Board of Elections.

sec04-card-sec04-F015.front: Who inside a motor vehicle in the District is legally required to wear a seat belt?
sec04-card-sec04-F015.expected_back: The vehicle's driver and all passengers are required to wear seat belts.

sec04-card-sec04-F016.front: How must licensed DC motorists operate a cell phone if talking while driving?
sec04-card-sec04-F016.expected_back: District drivers must use a cellular phone hands-free while driving.

sec04-card-sec04-F017.front: Within how many days must a DC resident report a residential address change to DMV?
sec04-card-sec04-F017.expected_back: A resident's address change must be reported to DMV within sixty days.

sec04-card-sec04-F018.front: What must you surrender to DC DMV before canceling liability insurance on a registered vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F018.expected_back: Vehicle insurance must stay in force throughout registration; surrender the tags before canceling coverage.

sec04-card-sec04-F019.front: Which three items must a driver hand over when stopped by law enforcement?
sec04-card-sec04-F019.expected_back: A driver stopped by law enforcement must provide a valid license, vehicle registration and evidence of insurance.

sec04-card-sec04-F020.front: Can moving violations committed outside Washington, DC add points to your DC driving record?
sec04-card-sec04-F020.expected_back: Moving violations committed inside or outside the District can add points to a DC driving record.

sec04-card-sec04-F021.front: Which three outcomes trigger DC DMV point assessment, and what does paying a ticket legally mean?
sec04-card-sec04-F021.expected_back: DMV assesses points after a liability finding, a conviction or payment of the ticket; paying the ticket admits liability.

sec04-card-sec04-F022.front: For how long do assessed violation points remain active on a DC driving record?
sec04-card-sec04-F022.expected_back: Points remain active on the driving record for two years.

sec04-card-sec04-F023.front: How can a DC driver earn a Good Point on their driving record?
sec04-card-sec04-F023.expected_back: A driver maintaining a valid DC license for a full calendar year without pointable moving violations may qualify for a Good Point.

sec04-card-sec04-F024.front: What penalty hits when a DC driver accumulates ten or eleven active points?
sec04-card-sec04-F024.expected_back: Accumulating ten or eleven points brings a ninety-day license suspension, with driving barred until official reinstatement.

sec04-card-sec04-F025.front: What happens to a DC license upon reaching twelve or more active points?
sec04-card-sec04-F025.expected_back: At twelve or more points, the source describes revocation and a six-month wait before reinstatement eligibility.

sec04-card-sec04-F026.front: Which program is mandatory after conviction for a covered criminal alcohol-driving offense in DC?
sec04-card-sec04-F026.expected_back: A driver convicted of a covered criminal alcohol-driving offense must enroll in the mandatory ignition-interlock program.

sec04-card-sec04-F027.front: What minimum license revocation lengths apply to first, second, and third-or-later covered alcohol convictions?
sec04-card-sec04-F027.expected_back: For the listed alcohol-related convictions, the source gives minimum revocation periods of six months for a first offense, one year for a second and two years for a third or later offense.

sec04-card-sec04-F028.front: When may a revoked driver legally drive again once the minimum revocation period ends?
sec04-card-sec04-F028.expected_back: After revocation, driving remains barred until official reinstatement and payment of the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F029.front: Which two DMV credentials or privileges can be suspended over unpaid child support?
sec04-card-sec04-F029.expected_back: Unpaid child support can lead to suspension of both a license and vehicle registration.

sec04-card-sec04-F030.front: What do District regulations say about items clipped to or hanging from your rearview mirror?
sec04-card-sec04-F030.expected_back: District regulations prohibit driving with objects attached to or hanging from the rearview mirror.

sec06-card-sec06-F001.front: Which four roadway behaviors does the District manual highlight as leading examples of aggressive driving?
sec06-card-sec06-F001.expected_back: Tailgating, hazardous lane changes, speeding and ignoring stop controls are prominent aggressive-driving behaviors.

sec06-card-sec06-F002.front: How should you plan your schedule, and after how many continuous hours does the manual advise taking a break?
sec06-card-sec06-F002.expected_back: Budget extra travel time and avoid driving continuously for more than three hours, as advised in the handbook.

sec06-card-sec06-F003.front: What two everyday habits prevent surprises ahead of you and around you in city traffic?
sec06-card-sec06-F003.expected_back: Keep enough space ahead to stop and signal every turn or lane change.

sec06-card-sec06-F004.front: How should you handle merging cars, the passing lane, and posted speed limits to keep traffic calm?
sec06-card-sec06-F004.expected_back: Let vehicles merge in an orderly way, keep the passing lane available and comply with posted speed limits.

sec06-card-sec06-F005.front: When should you use your horn, and what two interpersonal reactions should you avoid around angry drivers?
sec06-card-sec06-F005.expected_back: Use the horn for emergencies rather than expressing anger, and avoid rude gestures or confrontational eye contact.

sec06-card-sec06-F006.front: How should you choose your travel speed when driving after dark?
sec06-card-sec06-F006.expected_back: At night, choose a speed that permits stopping within the stretch of roadway visible ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F007.front: Where should your eyes look instead of staring straight into oncoming headlights at night?
sec06-card-sec06-F007.expected_back: Avoid staring at oncoming headlights; make brief checks of lane position, the road edge and the path ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F008.front: How do windshield cleanliness and sunglasses affect nighttime visibility and glare?
sec06-card-sec06-F008.expected_back: A clean windshield reduces glare problems, and sunglasses should not be worn at night.

sec06-card-sec06-F009.front: Which three roadside or street items demand extra scanning attention after dark?
sec06-card-sec06-F009.expected_back: At night, watch closely for pedestrians, parked or stopped vehicles and hard-to-see signs.

sec06-card-sec06-F010.front: Which painted stripe helps guide your lane position at night, and what backup stripe do you use when it is missing?
sec06-card-sec06-F010.expected_back: The road-edge line can guide nighttime position; where it is absent, use the center line as the guide.

sec06-card-sec06-F011.front: What visibility gear should you keep in the vehicle in case an emergency forces you to stop beside the road?
sec06-card-sec06-F011.expected_back: Carry a red warning light or flares for an unavoidable emergency stop beside the roadway.

sec06-card-sec06-F012.front: Does winter traction equipment let you drive normal dry-pavement speeds on snow or ice?
sec06-card-sec06-F012.expected_back: Winter traction equipment does not make ordinary dry-road speeds safe on snow or ice.

sec06-card-sec06-F013.front: What tire or traction equipment is required on designated District snow-emergency routes during a declared snow emergency?
sec06-card-sec06-F013.expected_back: Declared snow emergencies require the specified chains, snow tires or radial tires on designated snow-emergency routes.

sec06-card-sec06-F014.front: What must you clear off your vehicle before driving in winter weather, and what tool should stay aboard?
sec06-card-sec06-F014.expected_back: Remove ice and snow from windows and lamps and carry an ice scraper.

sec06-card-sec06-F015.front: How should you pull out and gauge available road grip at the start of a winter drive?
sec06-card-sec06-F015.expected_back: Start slowly on a winter road and test braking gently to learn how much traction is available.

sec06-card-sec06-F016.front: How should you adjust following distance and deceleration timing on snow or packed ice?
sec06-card-sec06-F016.expected_back: Increase space ahead on snow or packed ice and begin slowing well before turns and intersections.

sec06-card-sec06-F017.front: Which three sudden control inputs must you avoid on slick winter pavement?
sec06-card-sec06-F017.expected_back: Avoid abrupt braking, sharp steering and sudden acceleration on slippery winter roads.

sec06-card-sec06-F018.front: Which five emergency supplies does the manual recommend keeping in a winter car kit?
sec06-card-sec06-F018.expected_back: A winter emergency kit should include warning flares, first-aid supplies, a blanket, a shovel and sand or litter for traction.

sec06-card-sec06-F019.front: Which two vehicle reservoirs should you keep well supplied during cold-weather driving?
sec06-card-sec06-F019.expected_back: Keep fuel and windshield-cleaning fluid available during winter travel.

sec06-card-sec06-F020.front: Why is no single speed guaranteed safe on winter roads even if the previous block felt grippy?
sec06-card-sec06-F020.expected_back: No speed is guaranteed completely safe on snow or ice; conditions can change from one block or road segment to the next.

sec06-card-sec06-F021.front: What makes black ice so deceptive on dark pavement?
sec06-card-sec06-F021.expected_back: Black ice can be a hard-to-see refrozen layer on asphalt.

sec06-card-sec06-F022.front: Which roadway structures freeze before regular streets, and what happens to daytime meltwater after sunset?
sec06-card-sec06-F022.expected_back: Bridges and ramps can freeze before adjoining roads, and daytime thaw can refreeze after dark.

sec06-card-sec06-F023.front: Does four-wheel drive keep a vehicle from skidding or sliding on snow and ice?
sec06-card-sec06-F023.expected_back: Four-wheel drive does not prevent sliding on snow or ice.

sec06-card-sec06-F024.front: How should you press the brake pedal on a car equipped with anti-lock brakes?
sec06-card-sec06-F024.expected_back: With an anti-lock braking system, keep steady brake pressure instead of pumping the pedal.

sec06-card-sec06-F025.front: What two driving habits form the foundation of skid prevention?
sec06-card-sec06-F025.expected_back: Skid prevention includes avoiding sudden changes of direction or speed and slowing early for a stop.

sec06-card-sec06-F026.front: Where and how does the manual suggest practicing winter stopping and skid control?
sec06-card-sec06-F026.expected_back: A low-speed practice session on safe private property can help a driver learn stopping and skid recovery.

sec06-card-sec06-F027.front: How does braking technique on a vehicle without anti-lock brakes differ from the steady-pressure ABS method?
sec06-card-sec06-F027.expected_back: For a vehicle without anti-lock brakes, the handbook distinguishes pumping the pedal from the steady-pressure ABS method.

sec06-card-sec06-F028.front: When should you reduce speed for a curve, and how do wet, snowy, or icy surfaces change that rule?
sec06-card-sec06-F028.expected_back: Reduce speed before entering a curve, with greater caution as traction worsens from wet pavement to snow or ice.

sec06-card-sec06-F029.front: How do you recover if your vehicle's rear wheels begin sliding sideways?
sec06-card-sec06-F029.expected_back: To recover from a rear-wheel skid, release the accelerator and steer toward the direction the rear is sliding without panicking or braking.

sec06-card-sec06-F030.front: What is the safest trip choice in dense fog, and what should you do if lights appear ahead while driving?
sec06-card-sec06-F030.expected_back: Avoid travel in dense fog when possible; when driving is unavoidable, reduce speed further if lamps appear ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F031.front: Why must you stay ready for a sudden stop when you spot glowing taillights ahead in fog?
sec06-card-sec06-F031.expected_back: In fog, be prepared for a sudden stop because an apparent taillight may belong to a stopped vehicle.

sec06-card-sec06-F032.front: What should you do if fog grows so thick that even 10 mph is unsafe?
sec06-card-sec06-F032.expected_back: If fog makes even ten miles per hour impractical, leave the highway completely for a safe parking location.

sec06-card-sec06-F033.front: Which lights should you switch on in fog, and why are high beams the wrong choice?
sec06-card-sec06-F033.expected_back: Use dipped headlights or fog lamps in fog; high beams can reflect back and reduce the driver's view.

sec06-card-sec06-F034.front: Which roadway reference helps guide you through nighttime fog, and how should you schedule the drive?
sec06-card-sec06-F034.expected_back: Use the right roadway edge as a guide at night in fog and leave enough travel time to avoid rushing.

sec06-card-sec06-F035.front: Why shouldn't you pull out solely because an approaching car has its turn signal blinking?
sec06-card-sec06-F035.expected_back: Do not assume another driver will turn merely because a turn indicator is flashing.

sec06-card-sec06-F036.front: Why must you scan cross streets even when opposing traffic faces a red signal or stop sign?
sec06-card-sec06-F036.expected_back: Do not assume every approaching driver will obey a red signal or stop sign.

sec06-card-sec06-F037.front: Where should your eyes scan beyond the bumper directly ahead, and what mental plan should stay active?
sec06-card-sec06-F037.expected_back: Continuously consider an escape path and watch beyond the vehicle directly ahead for developing hazards.

sec06-card-sec06-F038.front: How should you react if an oncoming driver starts a pass that looks unlikely to finish in time?
sec06-card-sec06-F038.expected_back: When an approaching pass seems likely to fail, slow and check the shoulder and surrounding space for an escape route.

sec06-card-sec06-F039.front: If a crash cannot be prevented, what impact geometry does the manual tell you to avoid and seek instead?
sec06-card-sec06-F039.expected_back: If a collision cannot be avoided, the handbook advises trying to avoid a head-on impact and seeking an angled impact instead.

sec06-card-sec06-F040.front: Which equipment upkeep and mirror habit lower your risk of getting rear-ended?
sec06-card-sec06-F040.expected_back: To reduce rear-impact risk, maintain clean working brake lamps and check following traffic through the mirrors.

sec06-card-sec06-F041.front: Alongside keeping the back window unobstructed, when should you signal stops, turns, and lane moves?
sec06-card-sec06-F041.expected_back: Keep the rear window clear and signal stops, turns and lane changes early.

sec06-card-sec06-F042.front: How should you brake in traffic, and what is the smartest way to deal with a close tailgater?
sec06-card-sec06-F042.expected_back: Slow progressively rather than abruptly, and let a vehicle following too closely pass when possible.

sec06-card-sec06-F043.front: Which vehicle items and personal factors should you verify before setting out on highway travel?
sec06-card-sec06-F043.expected_back: Before highway travel, check tires, oil, coolant, mechanical condition, fuel and the driver's rest and fitness.

sec06-card-sec06-F044.front: When should you program navigation and study your planned highway route?
sec06-card-sec06-F044.expected_back: Set navigation and review the intended route before highway departure.

sec06-card-sec06-F045.front: How do the roles of a highway entrance ramp and an acceleration lane differ?
sec06-card-sec06-F045.expected_back: An entrance ramp leads toward the highway, while an acceleration lane gives space to approach traffic speed.

sec06-card-sec06-F046.front: May you cut across the solid painted line dividing a highway entrance area from main travel lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-F046.expected_back: Do not cross the solid painted boundary separating the highway from its entrance area.

sec06-card-sec06-F047.front: At an older, short highway entrance with no acceleration lane, when should you start building merge speed?
sec06-card-sec06-F047.expected_back: At a short highway entrance without an acceleration lane, begin accelerating only after identifying an available traffic gap.

sec06-card-sec06-F048.front: What visual checks are essential when merging onto a highway from a left-hand entrance?
sec06-card-sec06-F048.expected_back: At a left-side highway entrance, combine mirror observations with a shoulder check.

sec06-card-sec06-F049.front: When should you move into the proper lane for an upcoming right-side highway exit?
sec06-card-sec06-F049.expected_back: For a right-side highway exit, move into the appropriate lane well ahead of the exit.

sec06-card-sec06-F050.front: When should you begin slowing from highway speed for an exit ramp's advisory limit?
sec06-card-sec06-F050.expected_back: Maintain highway speed until entering the deceleration lane, then reduce speed for the ramp's posted advisory limit.

sec06-card-sec06-F051.front: What must you do if you accidentally steer onto the wrong highway exit ramp?
sec06-card-sec06-F051.expected_back: After taking the wrong exit, finish leaving the highway and find a lawful route back rather than reversing the exit maneuver.

sec06-card-sec06-F052.front: On a multilane limited-access highway, which side do slower vehicles use and where should most passing happen?
sec06-card-sec06-F052.expected_back: On a multilane limited-access highway, slower vehicles stay right and most passing should occur on the left.

sec06-card-sec06-F053.front: Is passing on the highway shoulder allowed, and what must a driver being overtaken avoid doing?
sec06-card-sec06-F053.expected_back: The highway shoulder is not a passing lane, and a driver being passed must not accelerate.

sec06-card-sec06-F054.front: After overtaking another car, what mirror cue tells you it is safe to merge back into its lane?
sec06-card-sec06-F054.expected_back: After overtaking, wait until the passed vehicle's headlights are visible in the inside mirror before returning to its lane.

sec06-card-sec06-F055.front: What three steps are required before sliding into an adjacent travel lane?
sec06-card-sec06-F055.expected_back: Signal lane changes and check the relevant blind spot by looking over the shoulder as well as using mirrors.

sec06-card-sec06-F056.front: What lane-positioning habit must you avoid off the rear quarters of a vehicle ahead?
sec06-card-sec06-F056.expected_back: Do not linger in the blind area of a vehicle ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F057.front: Around what feature is a roundabout built, and which direction do vehicles circulate?
sec06-card-sec06-F057.expected_back: A roundabout surrounds a central island, and vehicles circulate counterclockwise.

sec06-card-sec06-F058.front: How should you manage speed and entry controls when nearing a District roundabout?
sec06-card-sec06-F058.expected_back: Slow before a roundabout and obey the entry's yield, stop or signal control.

sec06-card-sec06-F059.front: According to the manual's roundabout lane guide, which approach lane do you pick for a right turn versus a left turn?
sec06-card-sec06-F059.expected_back: The manual's roundabout guidance places a right-turning entrant in the right lane and a left-turning entrant in the left lane.

sec06-card-sec06-F060.front: At a two-lane roundabout, which lane may a driver going straight ahead choose unless signs or markings direct otherwise?
sec06-card-sec06-F060.expected_back: At a two-lane roundabout, the source permits a straight-ahead entrant to use either lane, subject to the signs and markings.

sec06-card-sec06-F061.front: To which road users must an entering driver yield at a roundabout?
sec06-card-sec06-F061.expected_back: Entering roundabout traffic must yield to people walking or bicycling, motorcycles and vehicles already circulating.

sec06-card-sec06-F062.front: How should you manage your lane inside a roundabout and signal your departure?
sec06-card-sec06-F062.expected_back: Keep the chosen roundabout lane until exit and use the right indicator to communicate the exit.

sec06-card-sec06-F063.front: How should you behave around buses or large trucks navigating a roundabout?
sec06-card-sec06-F063.expected_back: Give large vehicles room for a wide path through a roundabout and do not overtake them there.

sec06-card-sec06-F064.front: What traffic checks are required before changing lanes inside a roundabout or peeling off to exit?
sec06-card-sec06-F064.expected_back: Before changing a roundabout lane or exiting, check adjacent and following traffic, including blind spots.

sec06-card-sec06-F065.front: When is stopping on a highway shoulder lawful?
sec06-card-sec06-F065.expected_back: A highway shoulder stop is reserved for a breakdown or another emergency, rather than ordinary parking.

sec06-card-sec06-F066.front: How should you mark a disabled vehicle on a limited-access highway, and should you walk down the road for help?
sec06-card-sec06-F066.expected_back: The source advises marking a disabled highway vehicle with a raised hood or white cloth and staying with it rather than walking along a limited-access road.

sec06-card-sec06-F067.front: May you back up on a highway, and how must you look and move when reversing anywhere else?
sec06-card-sec06-F067.expected_back: Do not reverse on a highway; when backing elsewhere, look directly behind as well as checking either side and move slowly.

sec06-card-sec06-F068.front: If regular brakes fail on a non-ABS vehicle, what sequence of actions does the manual recommend?
sec06-card-sec06-F068.expected_back: For brake failure on a non-ABS vehicle, the source first suggests trying the pedal pump and then the parking brake and a lower gear if braking does not return.

sec06-card-sec06-F069.front: What sound and pedal sensation are completely normal when anti-lock brakes engage hard?
sec06-card-sec06-F069.expected_back: ABS can make a rumbling sound and vibrate the pedal while it modulates wheel braking.

sec06-card-sec06-F070.front: What two things must you do simultaneously during an emergency stop with anti-lock brakes?
sec06-card-sec06-F070.expected_back: During emergency ABS braking, hold firm pedal pressure and continue steering toward the intended path.

sec06-card-sec06-F071.front: Where does the handbook suggest getting familiar with how your car's emergency ABS feels?
sec06-card-sec06-F071.expected_back: Practice emergency ABS use in an appropriate empty parking area to learn the vehicle's response.

sec06-card-sec06-F072.front: After driving through deep water, how do you test and dry wet brakes?
sec06-card-sec06-F072.expected_back: After deep water, test the brakes; the source's drying method uses low gear, slow travel and light brake application.

sec06-card-sec06-F073.front: At what distance interval should you keep testing wet brakes until normal stopping grip returns?
sec06-card-sec06-F073.expected_back: The handbook specifies checking wet-brake recovery at intervals of two hundred feet until normal braking returns.

sec06-card-sec06-F074.front: If steering suddenly fails, what is your first throttle move, and when do you brake gently versus urgently?
sec06-card-sec06-F074.expected_back: If steering control fails, ease off the accelerator; the handbook distinguishes gentle braking while the vehicle holds its path from urgent braking when it heads toward danger.

sec06-card-sec06-F075.front: Why must you never turn the ignition switch to the lock position while the vehicle is still rolling?
sec06-card-sec06-F075.expected_back: Never select the ignition lock position while moving because it can lock the steering.

sec06-card-sec06-F076.front: Which backup lights should you switch on if your main headlamps suddenly go dark at night?
sec06-card-sec06-F076.expected_back: If headlamps fail, use available parking, turn or emergency lamps as needed to leave the roadway safely.

sec06-card-sec06-F077.front: Where must you pull over if your vehicle catches fire, and what business must you never pull into?
sec06-card-sec06-F077.expected_back: For a vehicle fire, stop in an open place away from vegetation, buildings and other vehicles, and do not enter a service station.

sec06-card-sec06-F078.front: Who should you notify by phone with your location when a vehicle fire breaks out?
sec06-card-sec06-F078.expected_back: Use a phone to tell police the fire's location when one is available.

sec06-card-sec06-F079.front: What two immediate steps apply when fire starts inside the engine compartment?
sec06-card-sec06-F079.memory_hook: Shut engine off, keep hood closed
sec06-card-sec06-F079.expected_back: For an engine fire, turn the engine off as soon as possible and avoid opening the hood.

sec06-card-sec06-F080.front: Why must you keep van or trailer doors shut if a fire starts in the cargo area?
sec06-card-sec06-F080.expected_back: For a cargo fire, keep van or trailer doors shut because opening them supplies more oxygen.

sec06-card-sec06-F081.front: Under what two conditions should you even attempt to fight a vehicle fire yourself?
sec06-card-sec06-F081.expected_back: Try to fight a vehicle fire only when it is safe and you understand the extinguisher's operation.

sec06-card-sec06-F082.front: Where should you stand relative to wind and distance, and what part of the fire do you aim an extinguisher at?
sec06-card-sec06-F082.expected_back: Operate an extinguisher from upwind and as far from the fire as practical, aiming toward its base rather than the upper flames.

sec06-card-sec06-F083.front: Why isn't a fire truly out the moment visible flames disappear?
sec06-card-sec06-F083.expected_back: Flames disappearing does not prove a fire cannot restart; burning material must cool.

sec06-card-sec06-F084.front: How should you evade and warn an oncoming vehicle driving toward you in your lane, and which lane must you avoid?
sec06-card-sec06-F084.expected_back: When another vehicle approaches in your lane, slow and move right while warning with horn and headlamps; do not move into the lane it has just left.

sec06-card-sec06-F085.front: If your car stalls on railroad tracks with a train approaching, which direction must you evacuate on foot?
sec06-card-sec06-F085.expected_back: If a train approaches a vehicle stalled on the tracks, get out and move alongside the track toward the approaching train to avoid collision debris.

sec06-card-sec06-F086.front: What three immediate control habits apply if your wheels drop unexpectedly off the pavement edge?
sec06-card-sec06-F086.expected_back: After leaving the pavement unexpectedly, release the accelerator, hold the wheel firmly and avoid abrupt braking.

sec06-card-sec06-F087.front: What three conditions must be met before steering back onto the roadway after running onto the shoulder?
sec06-card-sec06-F087.expected_back: Do not re-enter from the roadside until control returns, speed is fifteen miles per hour or less and surrounding traffic has been checked.

sec07-card-sec07-F001.front: When steering back onto the pavement from the roadside, what lane boundaries must your car avoid crossing?
sec07-card-sec07-F001.expected_back: When returning from the roadside, keep the vehicle from crossing the center line or entering another traffic lane.

sec07-card-sec07-F002.front: How do pavement rumble strips alert a drifting or approaching driver, and what do they warn about?
sec07-card-sec07-F002.expected_back: Rumble strips create tire noise and vibration to warn of hazards or proximity to the road edge.

sec07-card-sec07-F003.front: Which six tire or valve-stem defects should you look for during a walk-around inspection?
sec07-card-sec07-F003.expected_back: Inspect tires for excessive wear, exposed fabric, cuts, separation, mismatched sizes and damaged valve stems.

sec07-card-sec07-F004.front: What two tire-fitment mistakes must you avoid on the same axle or inside wheel wells?
sec07-card-sec07-F004.expected_back: Avoid incompatible tire construction on the same axle and tires that touch other tires or vehicle parts.

sec07-card-sec07-F005.front: What two dangerous failures can a bent or cracked wheel rim cause?
sec07-card-sec07-F005.expected_back: Bent or cracked rims can let a tire lose air or come off the wheel.

sec07-card-sec07-F006.front: What can rust streaks around lug nuts signal, and when should you recheck lug tightness?
sec07-card-sec07-F006.expected_back: Rust near wheel nuts can indicate looseness, and nut tightness should be checked after a tire change.

sec07-card-sec07-F007.front: How does the manual classify missing lug fasteners, damaged lock rings, and weld-repaired wheels?
sec07-card-sec07-F007.expected_back: Missing wheel fasteners and damaged lock rings are hazardous; repaired-by-welding wheels are described as unsafe.

sec07-card-sec07-F008.front: What three immediate control rules apply the instant a tire blows out at speed?
sec07-card-sec07-F008.expected_back: At a blowout, hold the steering wheel securely, avoid braking and let the vehicle slow while finding a safe place off the roadway.

sec07-card-sec07-F009.front: How do you guide and finish your pull-off onto the right shoulder after a tire blowout?
sec07-card-sec07-F009.expected_back: Signal a move toward the right shoulder and wait until the vehicle has nearly stopped before completing the blowout stop.

sec07-card-sec07-F010.front: How far off the road should you position a disabled vehicle, and which vehicle lights should go on?
sec07-card-sec07-F010.expected_back: For a disabled vehicle, move all wheels clear of the roadway if possible and use parking lamps or emergency flashers.

sec07-card-sec07-F011.front: Which three portable warning devices can alert approaching motorists to your disabled car?
sec07-card-sec07-F011.expected_back: Available warning lights, reflective triangles or flares can alert other drivers to a disabled vehicle.

sec07-card-sec07-F012.front: What two simple visual signals on the car itself show passing help that your vehicle is disabled?
sec07-card-sec07-F012.expected_back: A white cloth or raised hood is another disabled-vehicle signal described in the handbook.

sec07-card-sec07-F013.front: What does right-of-way mean, and what always outranks insisting on your legal turn to go?
sec07-card-sec07-F013.expected_back: Right-of-way describes priority to proceed lawfully, but a driver must put safety ahead of insisting on that priority.

sec07-card-sec07-F014.front: Alongside obeying intersection signs and signals, how must you treat a vehicle that entered before you?
sec07-card-sec07-F014.expected_back: At an intersection, obey the applicable signal or sign and yield to a vehicle that entered before you.

sec07-card-sec07-F015.front: Who must you yield to before turning left across oncoming lanes or into a driveway?
sec07-card-sec07-F015.expected_back: Before turning left across traffic or into a driveway, yield to people and vehicles whose paths would conflict.

sec07-card-sec07-F016.front: What must you do before pulling onto a public street from a private road or driveway?
sec07-card-sec07-F016.expected_back: Entering a public road from a driveway or private road requires stopping and yielding to approaching traffic and pedestrians.

sec07-card-sec07-F017.front: Even with a steady green traffic light, who must you still yield to before driving through?
sec07-card-sec07-F017.expected_back: A green signal still requires yielding to people and vehicles already occupying the intersection.

sec07-card-sec07-F018.front: How must you respond when an emergency vehicle approaches running flashing lights or a siren?
sec07-card-sec07-F018.expected_back: An emergency vehicle using a siren or flashing lights has priority; move to the curb and stop until it passes.

sec07-card-sec07-F019.front: How far back must you stay behind fire apparatus responding to an alarm?
sec07-card-sec07-F019.expected_back: Do not follow responding fire equipment within five hundred feet.

sec07-card-sec07-F020.front: May you drive onto a city block where emergency or fire vehicles are stopped working a scene?
sec07-card-sec07-F020.expected_back: Do not drive into a block occupied by stopped emergency or fire vehicles; turn onto a different street instead.

sec07-card-sec07-F021.front: What authorities and signal displays limit a pedestrian's right-of-way at crossings?
sec07-card-sec07-F021.expected_back: Pedestrian crossing priority is subject to traffic officers and traffic controls, including a red pedestrian crossing indication.

sec07-card-sec07-F022.front: Where pedestrian signals are installed, which signal heads govern walkers versus drivers?
sec07-card-sec07-F022.expected_back: Pedestrians follow WALK and DON'T WALK indications while drivers follow the ordinary vehicle signals.

sec07-card-sec07-F023.front: When must a District motorist come to a complete stop rather than merely slowing for a pedestrian in a crosswalk?
sec07-card-sec07-F023.expected_back: Stop completely for a crosswalk pedestrian on your half of the road or approaching closely from the adjacent half where the pedestrian is endangered.

sec07-card-sec07-F024.front: Why is it illegal to pass another vehicle stopped at an intersection crosswalk?
sec07-card-sec07-F024.expected_back: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at an intersection crosswalk to allow someone to cross.

sec07-card-sec07-F025.front: What curb-leaving action does the handbook forbid pedestrians from taking in front of close traffic?
sec07-card-sec07-F025.expected_back: A pedestrian may not step from safety into a vehicle's path so suddenly that yielding is impossible.

sec07-card-sec07-F026.front: How must a driver react when someone crosses outside a crosswalk without legal right-of-way?
sec07-card-sec07-F026.expected_back: Even when a pedestrian crosses outside a crosswalk without priority, the handbook directs drivers to yield rather than cause a collision.

sec07-card-sec07-F027.front: Who yields when a walker crosses at street grade despite a pedestrian bridge or tunnel, and what duty stays on drivers?
sec07-card-sec07-F027.expected_back: A pedestrian crossing where a bridge or tunnel is provided must yield to roadway traffic, while drivers retain the responsibility to avoid harming pedestrians.

sec07-card-sec07-F028.front: Between two nearby signalized intersections, how does the manual describe crossing the street?
sec07-card-sec07-F028.expected_back: Between nearby signal-controlled intersections, the source describes crossing in a marked crosswalk or after yielding to approaching traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-F029.front: How should you treat pedestrians who are deaf or who travel with service animals or mobility aids?
sec07-card-sec07-F029.expected_back: Allow extra crossing time and care for pedestrians who are deaf or use mobility aids or service animals.

sec07-card-sec07-F030.front: Around which two groups of people near the street must you stay poised for an immediate stop?
sec07-card-sec07-F030.expected_back: Be ready to stop for children and for a person who appears confused or incapacitated.

sec07-card-sec07-F031.front: How does the shape of a school-crossing sign differ from a standard pedestrian-crossing warning sign?
sec07-card-sec07-F031.expected_back: A five-sided sign identifies a school crossing, while a diamond-shaped sign can warn of another pedestrian crossing.

sec07-card-sec07-F032.front: How do large trucks compare to passenger cars in acceleration, stopping, and cornering?
sec07-card-sec07-F032.expected_back: Trucks accelerate and stop over longer distances and need more turning room than passenger cars.

sec07-card-sec07-F033.front: Why do tractor-trailers frequently cruise in the middle lane of a multi-lane highway?
sec07-card-sec07-F033.expected_back: A tractor-trailer may use a middle highway lane to preserve maneuvering options and avoid disrupting entering or exiting traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-F034.front: How should you time and execute a pass alongside a tractor-trailer?
sec07-card-sec07-F034.expected_back: Pass a truck only with a clear legal passing lane and complete the maneuver rather than remaining beside it.

sec07-card-sec07-F035.front: When may you pull back in front of an overtaken truck, and what must you do with your speed?
sec07-card-sec07-F035.expected_back: After passing a truck, wait to see its front in the rearview mirror before returning and maintain speed instead of slowing abruptly.

sec07-card-sec07-F036.front: Where are the main blind areas located around a large commercial truck?
sec07-card-sec07-F036.expected_back: A truck has blind areas beside its cab, ahead of it and far behind its trailer.

sec07-card-sec07-F037.front: How should you position your car when following behind a large truck?
sec07-card-sec07-F037.expected_back: Position behind a truck so its driver can see your vehicle through a side mirror.

sec07-card-sec07-F038.front: Why must you switch to low beams when trailing a tractor-trailer after dark?
sec07-card-sec07-F038.expected_back: Dim headlights when following a truck at night so reflected glare does not blind the truck driver.

sec07-card-sec07-F039.front: What two precautions apply when stopping behind a heavy truck on an uphill grade?
sec07-card-sec07-F039.expected_back: When stopped behind a truck on an incline, leave rollback space and position where the driver can see you.

sec07-card-sec07-F040.front: What should you conclude if you cannot see the truck driver's face in the truck's side mirror?
sec07-card-sec07-F040.expected_back: If you cannot see a truck driver's face in the side mirror, do not assume that driver can see your vehicle.

sec07-card-sec07-F041.front: Why is tailgating closely behind a truck or transit bus doubly dangerous?
sec07-card-sec07-F041.expected_back: Avoid tailgating trucks and buses because their drivers cannot see vehicles in the rear blind area.

sec07-card-sec07-F042.front: Why must you never dart closely into the space ahead of a moving truck or bus?
sec07-card-sec07-F042.expected_back: Do not cut closely in front of a truck or bus; allow its greater stopping time and distance.

sec07-card-sec07-F043.front: What rule applies whenever you encounter a large truck reversing?
sec07-card-sec07-F043.expected_back: Never move across the rear of a truck that is backing.

sec07-card-sec07-F044.front: Why do large trucks swing into neighboring lanes to turn, and what curb gap must you stay out of?
sec07-card-sec07-F044.expected_back: A large truck may need neighboring lane space to turn; stay out of the gap between the truck and curb until it finishes.

sec07-card-sec07-F045.front: What visibility hazard do large truck tires kick up during rain or slush?
sec07-card-sec07-F045.expected_back: Truck spray in rain or snow can severely reduce the following driver's visibility.

sec07-card-sec07-F046.front: Which three equipment items must be ready and active when driving near trucks in wet weather?
sec07-card-sec07-F046.expected_back: Before wet-weather driving near trucks, ensure the wipers work, washer fluid is available and headlamps are on.

sec07-card-sec07-F047.front: What should you do if making your upcoming turn or exit would force you to cut across a truck's nose?
sec07-card-sec07-F047.expected_back: If an exit or turn would require cutting off a truck, slow and take the maneuver behind it instead.

sec07-card-sec07-F048.front: On which side does the manual advise overtaking a large truck, and how quickly should you clear?
sec07-card-sec07-F048.expected_back: The source's truck-passing guidance calls for passing fully on the left rather than lingering alongside.

sec07-card-sec07-F049.front: How does a tractor-trailer's large size distort your sense of its closing speed?
sec07-card-sec07-F049.expected_back: An approaching tractor-trailer can appear slower because of its size, so judge its distance and speed cautiously.

sec07-card-sec07-F050.front: How far away must you stop when a school vehicle flashes alternating red lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F050.expected_back: When a school vehicle displays alternating flashing red lamps while stopping or stopped, stop at least twenty feet from its front or rear.

sec07-card-sec07-F051.front: When may you start moving again after stopping for a school vehicle's red lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F051.expected_back: Do not resume past the school vehicle until its alternating red lamps stop flashing, and remain cautious afterward.

sec07-card-sec07-F052.front: When is oncoming traffic exempt from stopping for a school vehicle's flashing red lamps?
sec07-card-sec07-F052.expected_back: The school-vehicle stopping requirement does not apply across the divider on the opposite side of a divided highway.

sec07-card-sec07-F053.front: Where must you look twice for motorcycles, and why are they so easy to miss?
sec07-card-sec07-F053.expected_back: Check carefully for motorcycles at intersections, driveway exits and blind spots because their small profile makes them easy to overlook.

sec07-card-sec07-F054.front: How much of a traffic lane belongs to a motorcycle, and may a car squeeze past inside that lane?
sec07-card-sec07-F054.expected_back: A motorcycle has a right to the whole lane, and passing it within that same lane is illegal.

sec07-card-sec07-F055.front: Why must you keep generous space when following or overtaking a motorcycle?
sec07-card-sec07-F055.expected_back: Leave adequate space while passing or following a motorcycle because it can maneuver and stop quickly.

sec07-card-sec07-F056.front: How does District law treat bicyclists riding on streets compared to motor-vehicle drivers?
sec07-card-sec07-F056.expected_back: District bicyclists have roadway rights and duties like other vehicle users.

sec07-card-sec07-F057.front: How should you expect bicyclists to signal upcoming turns or lane moves?
sec07-card-sec07-F057.expected_back: Expect bicyclists to communicate turns with hand and arm signals rather than vehicle indicators.

sec07-card-sec07-F058.front: How should you manage speed, horn use, and lateral space when approaching a bicyclist?
sec07-card-sec07-F058.expected_back: Slow on approach to a bicycle, avoid startling its rider with a horn and leave room for sudden changes around hazards.

sec07-card-sec07-F059.front: When is it safe to pass a bicycle and pull back into the lane ahead of the rider?
sec07-card-sec07-F059.expected_back: Wait to pass a bicycle until enough clearance is available and return only after the rider is visible in the rearview mirror.

sec07-card-sec07-F060.front: What must you do when oncoming traffic or narrow width prevents passing a bicyclist safely?
sec07-card-sec07-F060.expected_back: If a bicycle cannot be passed safely, reduce speed and follow until a safe passing opportunity develops.

sec07-card-sec07-F061.front: Where may a cyclist position at intersections, and what turning mistake must motorists avoid?
sec07-card-sec07-F061.expected_back: Expect a bicyclist to use a turn lane and avoid turning right across the rider's path.

sec07-card-sec07-F062.front: Why should you leave extra following distance behind a Metrobus or transit coach?
sec07-card-sec07-F062.expected_back: Extra following space behind a bus improves the view ahead and reduces its obstruction of sightlines.

sec07-card-sec07-F063.front: How should you pass a stopped transit bus, and what hazard should you anticipate around it?
sec07-card-sec07-F063.expected_back: A stopped transit bus may have pedestrians emerging nearby; pass at a safe speed and move over courteously when possible.

sec07-card-sec07-F064.front: How must you respond when a transit bus signals to pull into or out of traffic?
sec07-card-sec07-F064.expected_back: Give a bus priority when it enters or leaves the traffic stream.

sec07-card-sec07-F065.front: May you cut in front of a bus stopped for passengers at an intersection to make a right turn?
sec07-card-sec07-F065.expected_back: A driver may not turn right in front of a bus stopped at an intersection for passengers; remain or merge behind it.

sec07-card-sec07-F066.front: What minimum fine does the District handbook list for illegally turning right in front of a stopped passenger bus?
sec07-card-sec07-F066.expected_back: The source lists a fine of at least two hundred dollars for that prohibited turn ahead of a stopped bus.

sec07-card-sec07-F067.front: What pavement color and lettering mark a dedicated bus lane in the District?
sec07-card-sec07-F067.expected_back: Red pavement with Bus Only markings identifies a dedicated bus lane.

sec07-card-sec07-F068.front: Are District bus lanes active on identical schedules everywhere, and how do you tell when rules apply?
sec07-card-sec07-F068.expected_back: Bus-lane hours vary; signs state the days and periods when restrictions apply.

sec07-card-sec07-F069.front: Which four categories of users may lawfully travel in DC bus lanes without risking a ticket?
sec07-card-sec07-F069.expected_back: The handbook allows buses, bicycles, paratransit and emergency vehicles to use bus lanes, while ordinary unauthorized driving can be ticketed.

sec07-card-sec07-F070.front: Where no sign specifies otherwise, within what distance of an intersection may you enter a bus lane to turn right?
sec07-card-sec07-F070.expected_back: A right turn across a bus lane follows posted permission; without a sign, the source permits the turn within forty feet of the intersection.

sec07-card-sec07-F071.front: Before merging across a bus lane for a right turn, who must you check for and yield to?
sec07-card-sec07-F071.expected_back: Before crossing a bus lane to turn, check behind and yield to bicycles and buses already in that lane.

sec07-card-sec07-F072.front: What does an illuminated vertical bar on a dedicated bus-only signal allow?
sec07-card-sec07-F072.expected_back: The bus-only signal's vertical bar permits the bus to proceed before the ordinary green signal.

sec07-card-sec07-F073.front: How do the three-second flashing triangle and horizontal bar work on a bus-priority signal?
sec07-card-sec07-F073.expected_back: After three seconds, the flashing triangle warns that bus priority is ending, followed by a horizontal bar ending that priority.

sec07-card-sec07-F074.front: What traffic advantage does bus queue-jump signaling create at an intersection?
sec07-card-sec07-F074.expected_back: Bus queue-jump signaling gives a short priority movement before other traffic receives green.

sec07-card-sec07-F075.front: How does a DC streetcar travel, and can it share lanes with regular motor vehicles?
sec07-card-sec07-F075.expected_back: A streetcar carries passengers on fixed rails and can share a road with other traffic or use a separate right-of-way.

sec07-card-sec07-F076.front: How do streetcars move with posted speeds, and what must motorists do along streetcar corridors?
sec07-card-sec07-F076.expected_back: Streetcars observe posted speed limits and traffic flow; drivers must watch for them and follow the applicable road signs.

sec07-card-sec07-F077.front: On which side and with what precaution may you pass a stopped streetcar headed your way?
sec07-card-sec07-F077.expected_back: Pass a stopped streetcar going your direction on the left only when safe, with special care for passengers boarding or leaving.

sec07-card-sec07-F078.front: What penalties apply if you stop, stand, or park on a streetcar guideway or beside a platform?
sec07-card-sec07-F078.expected_back: Stopping, standing or parking on a streetcar guideway or beside a platform can lead to a fine and vehicle removal.

sec07-card-sec07-F079.front: How must your vehicle be positioned when parking along a streetcar corridor?
sec07-card-sec07-F079.expected_back: Along a streetcar route, park clear of the rails and within the solid white boundary.

sec07-card-sec07-F080.front: What two curb rules apply to car doors and double-parking along a streetcar route?
sec07-card-sec07-F080.expected_back: Check for a streetcar before opening a parked vehicle's doors, and do not double-park along the route.

sec10-card-sec10-F001.front: Where do you position your car and how do you steer to start a three-point turnabout?
sec10-card-sec10-F001.memory_hook: Right edge, roll slow, steer left
sec10-card-sec10-F001.expected_back: To begin the described turnabout, start near the right road edge, check for traffic and move forward slowly while steering left.

sec10-card-sec10-F002.front: Where do you halt the first forward arc of a turnabout, and how do you back up next?
sec10-card-sec10-F002.expected_back: Stop the first turnabout movement just short of the left curb or road edge, then reverse slowly while steering right.

sec10-card-sec10-F003.front: Once you halt just before the right road edge while backing, how do you finish the turnabout?
sec10-card-sec10-F003.expected_back: After stopping short of the right edge, move forward slowly while steering left to complete the turnabout or repeat as necessary.

sec10-card-sec10-F004.front: Which two speed standards must every driver satisfy at the same time on the road?
sec10-card-sec10-F004.expected_back: A driver must satisfy both posted speed limits and the requirement for a reasonable speed under present hazards and conditions.

sec10-card-sec10-F005.front: Why must you actively manage your speed around anyone already on or stepping onto the street?
sec10-card-sec10-F005.expected_back: Control speed to avoid colliding with people or vehicles on or entering the roadway.

sec10-card-sec10-F006.front: When is driving unusually slowly allowed even if it holds up normal traffic behind you?
sec10-card-sec10-F006.expected_back: Do not impede normal reasonable traffic through unnecessary slow driving, except when safety or law requires reduced speed.

sec10-card-sec10-F007.front: When does the handbook advise matching the pace of surrounding vehicles?
sec10-card-sec10-F007.expected_back: Matching ordinary traffic speed is advised only within the applicable speed limit.

sec10-card-sec10-F008.front: What default speed limit applies on District city streets when no other limit is posted?
sec10-card-sec10-F008.expected_back: The handbook lists twenty miles per hour on District city streets unless signs set a different limit.

sec10-card-sec10-F009.front: What default speed limit governs District alleys and school zones unless signs set another number?
sec10-card-sec10-F009.expected_back: The handbook lists fifteen miles per hour in District alleys and school zones unless otherwise posted.

sec10-card-sec10-F010.front: How do higher impact speeds affect a crash even when something else triggered the wreck?
sec10-card-sec10-F010.expected_back: Higher collision speeds increase the severity of injury and damage even when another factor causes the crash.

sec10-card-sec10-F011.front: What sign color and shape combination posts the legal maximum speed?
sec10-card-sec10-F011.expected_back: Black text on a white rectangular speed-limit sign specifies the legal maximum.
